title: Chapter 195 Peak Of The Immortal Emperor
content:
Chapter 195 Peak Of The Immortal Emperor

"In the next life, live more wisely."

Standing in place, Wan Feng clenched his fist with one hand, and all the forbidden power in the entire domain suddenly gathered towards one point.

Seeing this scene, the rest of the people began to take advantage of this gap to escape from the domain.

"You!"

"Ancestor, save me!"

Feeling the threat of death, the head of the Immortal Soul Sect felt cold in his heart.

However, the old ancestor who always answered questions in the past no longer had any breath this time.

Suddenly, the head of the Immortal Soul Sect looked desperate.

"Ah!! You want to kill me, let's see if you have the strength to do it!!"

Although he knew he couldn't beat him, how could he surrender?

The breath of the fifth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm surged from the head of the Immortal Soul Sect, but in front of Wan Feng's forbidden power, it seemed a little insignificant.

The people around who had not yet left saw the cultivation level of the head of the Immortal Soul Sect, and their expressions were also slightly stunned.

"Only the fifth level?"

After all, the strength of the Immortal Soul Sect has always been the best in the Wood Immortal Realm.

It was a little surprising that the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect didn't even have the strength of the late Immortal Emperor Realm.

"It seems that this guy is really just a puppet."

Boom!

A deafening explosion sounded.

The leader of the Immortal Soul Sect was directly blown away by the terrifying forbidden power.

"Well? Lord Wan, are you okay?"

On the wall, Wan Feng, who used this move, suddenly turned pale, his body was unstable, and he almost fell over.

Fortunately, Xun Heng, who was standing by, quickly supported Wan Feng.

"No, it's okay."

Wan Feng shook his head.

This move was really powerful. With one move, Wan Feng, who was now at the fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, killed the leader of the Immortal Soul Sect, who was at the fifth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Even the consumption was really great.

His cultivation was a hard injury. It seemed that it was most important to seize the time to restore his cultivation.

And this move of his own also completely shocked everyone present.

Seeing this, the people from other forces could only wait obediently and dared not say a word.

At this moment.

A terrifying breath suddenly rose from the distant sky.

Everyone was shocked and looked in that direction.

"That is,, Hanyu!"

Hanyu.

Wan Feng was shocked.

It was the master.

And at this time, Hanyu.

Rumble!

The powerful breath shook the void and began to shatter.

In a special relic.

Yan Lingyun was sitting cross-legged on a stone pool, and the terrifying breath was pouring out of her body.

How strong is this breath?

Even comparable to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

On the side, Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun, whose breath was surging at the moment, and sighed in his heart.

His wife is really far-sighted.

As early as the first time she came to the Wood Immortal Realm, she had anticipated the outcome, so she stored her power here.

Now, although many years have passed and the power left here has weakened, after Yan Lingyun absorbed it, she still recovered to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

From the early stage of the Immortal Realm directly to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

This span is really huge.

However, compared with Lu Daosheng's strength, there is still some gap.

Who made him hang on the wall?

And the ruins here are where Yan Lingyun lived in the Wood Immortal Realm.

Now it is already a wreckage.

I don't know how long it took, the breath finally slowly dissipated.

Yan Lingyun, who was sitting cross-legged on the ground, slowly opened his eyes and exhaled a turbid air from his mouth.

"Hu~ The peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, barely enough."

Listen to it, people say it or not.

Unfortunately, there are only Lu Daosheng and two people here, and each one is more exaggerated than the other.

"Haha, Lingyun, who should we visit first?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng got on the right track directly.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun pondered for a moment and immediately thought of it.

"Go to the Immortal Soul Sect."

And Lu Daosheng didn't say much, he directly pulled Yan Lingyun and headed towards the Immortal Soul Sect.

Immortal Soul Sect.

"Ancestor, the sect master is dead."

In the dark hall, the great elder of the Immortal Soul Sect trembled and spoke.

In the center of the hall, an old man in tattered clothes raised his head slightly.

"If he's dead, he's dead."

If it were anyone else, he would stand up and make the decision for him.

But the other party was the person he didn't want to face in his life.

Crazy Emperor.

That guy almost became his inner demon.

Speaking of which, he had some connection with the Crazy Emperor in the past, and at that time he was already the top strong man in the Wood Immortal Realm.

But facing Wan Feng who had not grown up yet, he could do nothing.

Until later, Wan Feng improved faster and faster, which once caused him to have an inner demon.

I thought I would never be able to do anything to Wan Feng in my life.

But God gave him a chance.

Wan Feng was raging, and the forbidden power in his body went crazy.

Seeing this opportunity, he did not hesitate at all, and directly called eight Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses who were equivalent to him on the grounds of endangering the Wood Immortal Realm.

And he was also the only one who knew something about Wan Feng.

He knew the horror of Wan Feng's forbidden power, so in that battle, he had been fishing in troubled waters and hiding behind the crowd.

It was because of this that he successfully avoided the erosion of the forbidden power.

He knew what harm would be caused by the erosion of the forbidden power.

After that battle, the other seven Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses were either seriously injured, their foundations were damaged, and they could not make any progress, or they died not long after.

Until now, he was the only one who hadn't been in trouble.

So he took this opportunity to develop the Immortal Soul Sect to its extreme.

The other immortal emperors who were still alive noticed his intention, but they were powerless to stop him.

He was the biggest winner.

But now, the Mad Emperor actually broke the seal and came back to the world, which he could never have imagined.

"Ancestor, what if the Mad Emperor came to our door?"

The Immortal Soul Sect's great elder was terrified.

Even the sect master was killed, which meant that he didn't take the Immortal Soul Sect seriously at all.

Hearing this, the Immortal Soul Ancestor snorted, "What are you afraid of? After so many years, how can that guy recover?"

"Even if she really comes to our door, I may not be afraid of her."

At worst, I can use the same trick again and find some enemies to deal with her together.

If I can seal her once, I can seal her a second time.

Seeing that his ancestor didn't take it seriously, the Immortal Soul Sect's great elder had some concerns in his heart.

Just as he was about to say something else, a terrifying aura suddenly appeared outside the Immortal Soul Sect.

Boom!

Suddenly, the entire Immortal Soul Sect trembled.

"How dare you! Who dares to be so rude!"

Several powerful figures soared into the sky and came to the outside of the Immortal Soul Sect.

It must be said that the strength of the Immortal Soul Sect is indeed terrifying.

There are as many as five mid-stage Immortal Emperor Realm masters, and if the previous Immortal Soul Sect Master is included, there are six.

It is much stronger than the other special forces.

Moreover, this is only on the surface.

"Call your ancestors out."

Yan Lingyun spoke directly in the void.

Hearing this, the Immortal Soul Sect masters looked angry, "Don't you take my Immortal Soul Sect too seriously."

At this time, Yan Lingyun's aura burst out from his body again.

At this moment, the aura of the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm is unobstructed.

"I'll say it one last time, call your ancestors out!"

Boom!

The sound, mixed with the aura of a peak Immortal Emperor, spread throughout the entire Immortal Soul Sect.

At first, everyone in the Immortal Soul Sect thought it was just an ordinary provocation.

It was not until the peak Immortal Emperor appeared that everyone finally realized something was wrong.
